newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila says no final plan on Meralco shares sale.
newsitem.headline: Manila says no final plan on Meralco shares sale.

text.p: Philippine Commission on Good Government (PCGG) chairman Magtanggol Gunigundo said on Wednesday there was no final plan yet on the sale of sequestered Manila Electric Co (Meralco) shares.
"We are still waiting for the final go-signal from the Committee on Privatisation," Gunigundo told Reuters by telephone.
He said the committee is still deliberating on the mode and timing of the sale.
The PCGG, the custodian of the sequestered shares, had expressed its intention to sell Meralco shares in June this year.
The government currently holds about 30 percent of Meralco, he said.
The PCGG is yet to shortlist the seven investment houses which have offered to underwrite the sale of the shares, he said.
A rumour saying the sale was imminent had propelled Meralco shares higher in late trade on Wednesday.
The A shares went up by five pesos to 105 pesos, while the B shares, which are open to foreign investors, gained 13.00 pesos, or 7.47 percent to 187 pesos.
